table plant name text, part pick Morning|Afternoon|Evening = Morning

        it.part faint
      toggle it.plant_done

seed.request: ghar ka budget

start:
app "Budget" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Food|Bills|Travel|Fun|Health
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
monthnav m
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
"Safe to spend" round((budget - spent) / (monthdays(m) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day. Last month:" sum(spend.amount prev month) faint
draw 100, 50
  line 0, 50, 100, 0 stroke edge
  poly stroke accent thick 2
    each days month of m
      pt 100 * monthday(it) / monthdays(m), 50 - 50 * clamp(sum(spend.amount month of m where at <= it) / budget, 0, 1)
each spend month of m by category
  stack tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
    row
      it.key grow
      sum(it.amount) bold
    draw 100, 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 3 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted)
form spend
list spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day

seed.request: a habit tracker with a daily streak

start:
app "Habits" check ocean
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 36 radius 6 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 70 radius 6 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

app "Attendance" users ocean
table student name text
table absent student ref student
state d date = today
state adding bool = no
let away = count(absent on d)
row align center gap 1
  button "<" tap set d = d - 1
  dayname(d) monthday(d) monthname(d) bold
  if d >= today
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set d = d + 1
if count(student) = 0
  stack card gap 2
    "No students yet" head
    "Add the names in your class, then tap a name to mark that child absent." color muted
else
  stack gap 0
    count(student) - away "of" count(student) "present" big
    if away > 0
      away "absent today" color muted
    else
      "Everyone is here" color good
  grid 3 gap 1
    each student sort name as s

        s.name bold
        if count(s.absent on d) > 0
          "Absent" small
        else
          "Present" faint
  "Tap a name to mark absent. Everyone starts present." faint
  section "This month"
    each student sort count(it.absent month of d) desc top 5 as s
      row
        s.name grow
        plural(count(s.absent month of d), "day") "absent" color muted
button if(adding, "Close", "Add student") tap set adding = not adding

start:
app "Budget" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Groceries|Bills|Transport|Eating_out|Health|Other = Groceries
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
let now_month = monthname(m) = monthname(today)
let day = if(now_month, monthday(today), monthdays(m))
let left = budget - spent
row align center gap 1 bar
  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)
  monthname(m) bold grow align center
  if now_month
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set m = addmonths(m, 1)
stack card gap 3
  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted
  row gap 1 align end
    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 4
    rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "Day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
stack card gap 2
  "Spending through the month" head
  row gap 3
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1, 16, 2 fill accent
      "Spent so far" faint
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1.5, 16, 1 fill muted
      "Even pace" faint
  plot 1..monthdays(m), 0..max(budget, spent) axes gridlines
    line 1, 0, monthdays(m), budget stroke muted thick 1
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      each days month of m
        if monthday(it) <= day
          pt monthday(it), sum(spend.amount month of m where at < it + 1)
    circle day, spent, 1 fill accent
    tick 1, "1"
    tick round(monthdays(m) / 2), round(monthdays(m) / 2)
    tick monthdays(m), monthdays(m)
  spent "spent by day" day "against an even pace of" round(budget * day / monthdays(m)) faint
stack card gap 3
  row
    "By category" head grow
    "Tap to filter" faint
  if spent = 0
    "No spending this month yet." color muted
  each spend month of m by category sort amount desc
    stack gap 1 tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
      row
        it.key grow bold
        round(sum(it.amount) * 100 / spent) "%" faint
        sum(it.amount)
      draw 100, 2
        rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 2 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
row gap 2 align center
  if(cat = "", "All expenses", cat) head grow
  if cat != ""
    button "Show all" tap set cat = ""
each spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day as g empty "Nothing here. Expenses you add show up here, newest first."
  row
    g.key bold faint grow
    sum(g.amount) faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.what
        r.category faint
      r.amount bold

lost: rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
added: rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 2 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
daybars last 7 days, sum(spend.amount on it)
list spend month of m by day

setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
let now_month = monthname(m) = monthname(today)
let day = if(now_month, monthday(today), monthdays(m))
let left = budget - spent
row align center gap 1 bar
  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)
  monthname(m) bold grow align center
  if now_month
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set m = addmonths(m, 1)
stack card gap 3
  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted
  row gap 1 align end
    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 2
    rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 2 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
section "Last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(spend.amount on it)
list spend month of m by day

        sum(it.amount)

start:
app "Workouts" dumbbell ink
table lift exercise text, kg num 0.. = 0 unit "kg", sets num 1..20 = 3, reps num 1..100
state ex text = last(lift.exercise)
state adding bool = no
state d new lift keep
let vol = sum(lift week, it.kg * it.sets * it.reps)
let before = sum(lift prev week where weekday(at) <= weekday(today), it.kg * it.sets * it.reps)
let trained = count(days week, count(lift on it) > 0)
let hi = max(lift.kg last 35 days where exercise = ex)
let lo = min(lift.kg last 35 days where exercise = ex)
row bar
  button if(adding, "Close", "Log exercise") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
if adding
  stack card gap 3
    field d
    "Use 0 kg for bodyweight moves like push-ups." faint
    button "Save set" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
row gap 1
  each days week
    stack grow gap 1 align center
      dayname(it) tiny color if(it = today, ink, muted)
      box height 36 radius 8 fill if(count(lift on it) > 0, accent, soft)
        it if(count(lift on it) > 0, ", trained", ", rest") opacity 0
stack gap 1
  if count(lift today) > 0
    plural(count(lift today), "exercise") "today," sum(lift today, it.sets) "sets" head
  else
    "No training yet today" head
  if trained > 0
    plural(trained, "day") "this week," round(vol / 100) / 10 "t moved" color muted
    if before > 0
      round((vol - before) * 100 / before) "% compared with the same days last week" faint
  else
    "Nothing logged this week yet. Tap Log exercise after your first set." color muted
  if count(lift) > 0
    button "Repeat last set" tap add lift exercise = last(lift.exercise), kg = last(lift.kg), sets = last(lift.sets), reps = last(lift.reps)
stack card gap 3
  "Progress" head
  if count(lift) = 0
    "Your progress shows here once you have logged an exercise twice." color muted
  else
    scroll gap 1
      each lift last 60 days by exercise
        button it.key fill if(ex = it.key, ink, surface) tap set ex = it.key
    if count(lift last 35 days where exercise = ex) < 2
      "Log" ex "twice to see a line." color muted
    else
      row gap 3
        stack gap 0
          hi "kg" head
          "best set, 5 weeks" faint
        stack gap 0
          count(lift last 35 days where exercise = ex) "times" head
          "logged" faint
      plot 0..35, lo..hi axes gridlines
        poly stroke accent thick 2
          each lift last 35 days where exercise = ex sort at
            pt 35 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.kg
        circle 35 - (now - last(lift.at where exercise = ex)) / 1d, last(lift.kg where exercise = ex), 1 fill accent
        tick 1, today - 34
        tick 34, "Today"
      "Latest:" last(lift.kg where exercise = ex) "kg for" last(lift.reps where exercise = ex) "reps. Weights in kg." faint
"Recent" head
each lift last 14 days by day as g empty "Nothing logged in the last two weeks."
  g.key bold faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      r.exercise grow bold
      r.sets "x" r.reps color muted
      r.kg "kg"

  stack card gap 2
    "No habits yet" head

        "Last 30 days" faint

        "of all ticks" faint

        "Best streak" faint

    box width 16 height 16 radius 4 fill accent opacity 0.65

app "Savings" coin mint
table deposit amount money, note text?
setting goal money = 100000 "Savings goal"
state adding bool = no
state d new deposit
let total = sum(deposit.amount)
let p = clamp(total / goal, 0, 1)
let mon(d date) = if(month(d) = 1, "Jan", if(month(d) = 2, "Feb", if(month(d) = 3, "Mar", if(month(d) = 4, "Apr", if(month(d) = 5, "May", if(month(d) = 6, "Jun", if(month(d) = 7, "Jul", if(month(d) = 8, "Aug", if(month(d) = 9, "Sep", if(month(d) = 10, "Oct", if(month(d) = 11, "Nov", "Dec")))))))))))
row gap 4 align center
  draw 40, 120 width 72
    rect 14, 6, 12, 92 fill soft radius 6
    rect 14, 98 - 92 * p, 12, 92 * p fill accent radius 6
    circle 20, 106, 12 fill accent
  stack grow gap 1
    "Saved so far" color muted
    total big
    round(p * 100) "% of" goal color muted tap edit goal
    if total >= goal
      "Goal reached" bold color good
    else
      text goal - total "to go" bold
"Add to savings" head
row gap 1
  button "+ 1,000" fill accent grow tap add deposit amount = 1000
  button "+ 5,000" grow tap add deposit amount = 5000
  button if(adding, "Close", "Other") grow tap set adding = not adding

  stack card gap 3
    field d
    button "Save deposit" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
section "Last 6 months", sum(deposit.amount month) "this month"
  plot 0..6, 0..max(1000, max([5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0], sum(deposit.amount month of addmonths(today, 0 - it)))) axes gridlines
    each [5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0]
      rect index + 0.15, 0, 0.7, sum(deposit.amount month of addmonths(today, 0 - it)) fill if(it = 0, accent, muted) radius 3
      tick index + 0.5, mon(addmonths(today, 0 - it))
  "Rupees saved each month; this month in colour" faint
"Deposits" head
each deposit sort at desc top 12 as r empty "Nothing saved yet. Tap + 1,000 to make the first deposit."
  row card tap edit r swipe remove r
    stack grow gap 0
      r.note
      r.at faint
    r.amount bold
